registered: 2026-11-14, before any direct-acting comparison was run
scope: Direct-acting dampers (no rocker) on front_v11_final: damper on the upright (direct_upright) and on the lower wishbone (direct_lower). (1) Damper length change from static at every 1 mm of wheel-centre travel, -25 to +25 mm (every 5 mm for hand-entered tools): the motion ratio. (2) Axial member forces at the design position under the four link-load cases: all six members for direct_upright; the statically determinate ones (UF, UR, TR and the damper, PR) for direct_lower, where the lower wishbone carries the damper and its two leg forces depend on how the pivot reaction is split.

independent.why: same idealisation, different formulation and code

adams_view.why: commercial multibody solver; kinematics limits were 0.05 mm on the wheel centre, the damper is a single length

ard.why: values read off the ARD output by hand

chrono.why: Project Chrono (open-source multibody), run in the repo: agreement to solver tolerance (added 2026-11-15, before any Chrono run)

matlab.why: MATLAB Simscape Multibody: agreement to solver tolerance (added 2026-11-15, before any MATLAB run)

pass_rule: every travel point: |KinematiK - tool| <= damper_mm; every member, case and corner: |KinematiK - tool| <= abs_N + rel * |tool|
